```lean
import Algebra.NonUnitalNonAssocCommSemiring
import Algebra.NonUnitalSubsemiring

open NonUnitalSubsemiring

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_5} [NonUnitalNonAssocCommSemiring α] (a : α) :
  a ∈ NonUnitalSubsemiring.center α ↔ ∀ (b : α), Commute (AddMonoid.End.mulLeft b) (AddMonoid.End.mulLeft a) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    intro b
    have := NonUnitalNonAssocCommSemiring.mul_comm α a b
    exact Commute.refl _ _
  · intro h
    intro b
    rw [NonUnitalNonAssocCommSemiring.mul_comm α a b]
    exact Commute.refl _ _
```
